notes: Progress sheets for parent meetings: one printed page per student with the term grade, every score, a chart of how they moved, missing work, each term's grade, the report comment and lines for notes. Find it on a class's Students list, or Progress sheet on one student's page.
Choose the term and tick what goes on it; Print opens the print window, where you can pick a printer or Save as PDF. It is made on your computer and nothing is sent anywhere.
